rawContent: #ClimateCrisis is a #WomensRights issue. Women are more likely to die from #ExtremeWeather, be displaced, & are at more risk of food insecurity, forced marriage, trafficking, sexual violence & exploitation. @womenscs is calling for #ClimateAction on International Women’s Day #IWD

Globally, women are more vulnerable to #ClimateCrisis because they are more likely to live in poverty & have less access to education, land ownership, finance, & decision making structures. That's why advancing #WomensRights must be at the heart of #ClimateAction policy. #IWD2021
